verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents running its own instance locally: a single Docker container with an embedded database for one machine, a one-line install script, and Docker Compose. Developers can therefore stand up a local or dev instance to run workflows, and piece development offers fast browser reload. However, nothing documents CI testing of workflows, such as headless or CLI test runs or promoting flows between dev and prod instances, and a community user reported missing dev-setup instructions. missing for 10: CI/automated workflow testing tooling, CLI or headless flow execution, dev-to-prod flow promotion, independent hands-on confirmation of a smooth local dev workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run workflows locally or against a dev instance for development and CI testing
